parameters.content:
## Public website preview ONLY
1. Header Auth on Preview Webhook: Authorization / Bearer YOUR_RANDOM_TOKEN.
2. Select your OpenAI credential on all 3 HTTP nodes.
3. Model is GPT-6 Luna; change only in Validate and Plan.
4. Test the real website payload before publishing.
5. Vercel: N8N_REPLY_PREVIEW_WEBHOOK and N8N_REPLY_PREVIEW_TOKEN.

No Gmail nodes. One lookup maximum. Short public response, no internal prompt/keys.
See docs/reply-preview.md for exact setup and tests.
